description: Frontend: Replace ClassVotingBatchPanel in AdminSchedule.jsx with a new VotingBatchPanel component that uses GET/POST /api/voting-batch endpoints, and add an upfront batch status check to VotingPage.jsx at load time. This feature is independent of FEAT-001's file changes but depends on FEAT-001's API endpoints being present for runtime behavior.
steps: MODIFY e:\election-portaltab\frontend\src\components\admin\AdminSchedule.jsx. Delete the entire ClassVotingBatchPanel function (from its JSX comment header to its closing brace). Replace it with a new VotingBatchPanel component. The component signature is: `const VotingBatchPanel = ({ votingSchedule, students })` — it no longer needs setVotingSchedule, availableClasses, or studentCountByClass from props (derives classes internally from students). State: batchData (null initially), loading (true), error (''), selectedClass (''), selectedStudentIds (Set), submitting (false). On mount: call `api.get('/voting-batch')` and store result in batchData. Cooldown countdown: derive `cooldownSecs` from `batchData.batch.cooldownUntil` using `useEffect` with a 1-second interval — `Math.max(0, Math.ceil((new Date(cooldownUntil)-Date.now())/1000))`. Auto-refresh when open: `useEffect` that calls `api.get('/voting-batch')` every 5000ms when `batchData.batch.status==='open'`. On class change in dropdown: filter `students` prop for `s.class===cls && !s.hasVoted` and pre-populate `selectedStudentIds`. IDLE view: class dropdown (derive unique sorted classes from students prop), checkbox list with Select All, 'Open Batch (N students)' button → `api.post('/voting-batch',{className:selectedClass,studentIds:[...selectedStudentIds]})` then refresh. OPEN view: green styling, show className, batchNumber, openedAt (formatted), remainingCount, roster table with Name/StudentID/Status columns (✅ Voted / ⏳ Waiting based on `roster[i].hasVoted`), 'Close Batch' button → `api.post('/voting-batch/close')` then refresh. COOLDOWN view: amber styling, MM:SS countdown from cooldownUntil, progress bar `(cooldownSecs/120)*100`%, 'Clear Cooldown Early' button → `api.post('/voting-batch/clear-cooldown')` then refresh. When countdown hits 0, call refresh. Disabled hint when `votingSchedule.isActive===false`.

UPDATE the JSX render call inside AdminSchedule: change `<ClassVotingBatchPanel votingSchedule={votingSchedule} setVotingSchedule={setVotingSchedule} availableClasses={availableClasses} studentCountByClass={studentCountByClass} students={students} />` to `<VotingBatchPanel votingSchedule={votingSchedule} students={students} />`. The availableClasses and studentCountByClass derived values in AdminSchedule can remain (they may be used elsewhere) but are no longer passed to the batch panel.

MODIFY e:\election-portaltab\frontend\src\components\VotingPage.jsx. Add state: `const [batchStatus, setBatchStatus] = useState(null);` (null = not yet checked, {allowed,reason,batch} when loaded). In loadElectionData, after the existing Promise.all resolves and settings/positions/candidates are set, add: `try { const bsr = await api.get('/voting-batch/status'); setBatchStatus(bsr.data); } catch { /* non-fatal: if endpoint unreachable, allow through */ }`. Add a render guard before the existing `if (batchBlocked)` block: `if (batchStatus && batchStatus.allowed === false) { const msg = batchStatus.reason === 'not_in_batch' ? 'You are not in the current voting batch. Your teacher will let you know when it is your turn.' : 'No voting batch is currently open. Please wait for the admin to open a batch.'; return <the amber Please Wait screen with Clock icon and the msg>; }`. Reuse the same JSX structure as the existing batchBlocked screen (amber border, Clock icon, 'Please Wait' heading, Return to Dashboard button). In the submit error handler, also catch `err.response?.data?.error === 'not_in_batch'` alongside `'batch_not_open'` and set batchBlocked with appropriate data.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build in frontend/ completes with no errors
AdminSchedule Schedule tab shows VotingBatchPanel (not ClassVotingBatchPanel) — no toggle, no batchSize input; shows class dropdown and student checkbox list
When batch status is 'idle', the panel shows the class dropdown and Open Batch button
When batch status is 'open', the panel shows green roster table with remaining count and Close Batch button, auto-refreshing every 5s
When batch status is 'cooldown', the panel shows amber MM:SS countdown timer and Clear Cooldown Early button
A student who visits VotingPage when no batch is open sees a 'Please Wait' screen with the message 'No voting batch is currently open...' instead of the ballot
A student in VotingPage who is not in the current batch sees 'You are not in the current voting batch...'
verification: cd e:\election-portaltab\frontend && npm run build — must complete with exit code 0 and no errors
findings: ClassVotingBatchPanel fully replaced with VotingBatchPanel. New component: derives classes from students prop internally, no toggle/batchSize input, uses api.get/post('/voting-batch') endpoints. Three views: IDLE (class dropdown + checkbox list + Select All + Open Batch button with student count), OPEN (green panel, roster table with ✅/⏳ status, remainingCount, Close Batch button, 5s auto-refresh), COOLDOWN (amber panel, MM:SS countdown from cooldownUntil, progress bar, Clear Cooldown Early button). VotingPage: batchStatus state added, api.get('/voting-batch/status') called after Promise.all in loadElectionData (non-fatal catch), render guard added before batchBlocked check — shows amber Please Wait screen with Clock icon and reason-mapped message when allowed===false. Submit error handler updated to catch both 'batch_not_open' and 'not_in_batch'. Build: npm run build exits 0 with no errors (pre-existing chunk size warning unrelated). Committed: 133e17e.
